claims.claim: Walmart describes itself as a people‑led, technology‑powered omnichannel retailer that helps customers save money and live better by offering both physical stores and eCommerce options.
claims.quote: Walmart Inc. ("Walmart," the "Company" or "we") is a people-led, technology-powered omnichannel retailer dedicated to helping people around the world save money and live better by providing the opportunity to shop in both retail stores and through eCommerce, and to access our other service offerings.

claims.claim: The company’s strategy focuses on price leadership (EDLP/EDLC), digital expansion, and building trust with customers.
claims.quote: Our strategy is to make every day easier for busy families, operate with discipline, sharpen our culture and become more digital, and make trust a competitive advantage.

claims.claim: Walmart U.S. operates 4,611 stores across all 50 states, Washington D.C., and Puerto Rico.
claims.quote: Walmart U.S. is our largest segment and operates 4,611 stores in the U.S., including in all 50 states, Washington D.C. and Puerto Rico.

claims.claim: The U.S. segment provides a seamless omnichannel experience that links stores and eCommerce.
claims.quote: Omnichannel. Walmart U.S. provides a convenient and seamless omnichannel experience to customers, integrating retail stores and eCommerce.

claims.claim: AI‑powered tools are being used to improve customer experiences, associate productivity and operational efficiency.
claims.quote: Our strategies increasingly include the use of AI-powered tools to support customer and member-facing experiences, associate productivity and operational efficiency across our ecosystem.

claims.claim: The firm is continuously investing in supply‑chain automation and fulfillment capabilities.
claims.quote: We continue to invest in supply chain automation and our fulfillment and delivery capabilities to better serve our customers.

claims.claim: Walmart competes with a broad set of brick‑and‑mortar, eCommerce and omnichannel players across many retail formats and service categories.
claims.quote: Competition. We compete with brick and mortar, eCommerce and omnichannel retailers operating discount, department, retail and wholesale grocery, drug, dollar, variety and specialty stores, supermarkets, supercenter-type stores, membership-only warehouse clubs, gasoline stations and social commerce platforms, as well as companies that offer services in digital advertising, fulfillment and delivery services, health and wellness and financial services.

claims.claim: Key competitive levers include everyday low pricing, omnichannel services, expanding digital advertising and marketplace, new store openings/remodels, and technology/automation investments.
claims.quote: Investing in technology, automation, and our associates to deliver growth, expand operating margins and improve returns.

claims.claim: In the most recent quarter, net sales grew 5.2%, and when adjusted for currency effects the growth was 4.5%.
claims.quote: Revenue growth of 5.2%, up 4.5% in constant currency (cc)1

claims.claim: Global eCommerce sales rose 17% year‑over‑year, driven by store‑fulfilled pickup and delivery.
U.S. eCommerce sales increased 23% in the quarter, showing strong integration of online and physical channels.
claims.quote: eCommerce sales increased 23%, with strength in store-fulfilled delivery, advertising, and marketplace

claims.claim: The global advertising business grew 25% and the U.S. advertising segment grew 37% in the quarter.
Membership fee revenue grew 17% globally, and a new bundled membership offering was launched in the U.S.
International operations contributed roughly one‑fifth of consolidated net sales, underscoring the importance of global growth.
claims.quote: During fiscal 2026, our Walmart International operations generated approximately 19% of our consolidated net sales.

claims.claim: Management identifies failure to execute the omnichannel strategy and the cost of eCommerce/technology investments as a strategic risk that could materially affect market position and financial performance.
claims.quote: Failure to successfully execute our omnichannel strategy and the cost of our investments in eCommerce and technology may materially adversely affect our market position, net sales and financial performance.

claims.claim: Health pandemics, natural disasters, and other macro events are enumerated as operational risks that could disrupt operations and earnings.
claims.quote: Global or regional health pandemics or epidemics could negatively impact our business, financial position and results of operations.

claims.claim: Robust information‑system continuity is highlighted as critical, with the company emphasizing the need to keep business‑critical systems running without interruption.
claims.quote: Given the number of individual transactions we have each year, it is crucial that we maintain uninterrupted operation of our business-critical information systems.

claims.claim: Judgment: Continue prioritizing AI‑driven tools for customer experience and associate productivity, as the filing explicitly cites AI as a core element of the growth strategy (line 182) and the company warns that under‑investment could harm market position (line 283).
claims.quote: Our strategies increasingly include the use of AI-powered tools to support customer and member-facing experiences, associate productivity and operational efficiency across our ecosystem.

claims.claim: Judgment: Accelerate supply‑chain automation projects to mitigate the operational risk described in line 233 and to sustain the eCommerce growth demonstrated in the earnings release (line 12).
claims.quote: We continue to invest in supply chain automation and our fulfillment and delivery capabilities to better serve our customers.

gaps: No filing evidence quantifies the expected return on AI investments; the impact is discussed qualitatively only.
The 10‑K does not provide forward‑looking numeric targets for membership growth beyond the current quarter, limiting the ability to forecast long‑term revenue contribution.
Specific timing or magnitude of future store remodels and new openings is not disclosed; only a general commitment is mentioned.
